content: Productivity task-management dashboards: table-stakes widgets include stats/KPI cards (completion rate, open tasks, hours logged), task list with filtering/sorting, upcoming deadlines, calendar/schedule view, customizable widgets (add/remove, drag-drop), export reports. Personal dashboard shows assigned tasks/deadlines/time; team dashboard shows performance and attention-needed items. Best practice: limit visible items to 6-12 cards, consistent visual hierarchy, live data accuracy.
